alt: 地震體驗平台劇烈搖動，三名孩子緊握安全欄杆，睜大眼睛深受震撼，館員在旁冷靜照看。
scene_prompt: Meaning: an experience feels intensely shocking, thrilling and emotionally powerful. In a controlled science-museum earthquake simulator, three older children grip a sturdy safety rail on a low moving platform, wide-eyed and deeply shaken by the strong simulated motion. A calm instructor stands on stable flooring near an unlabelled emergency stop. Shelves and a water tank are strapped securely; tilted frames, rippling water and motion lines convey the shaking while the setting remains safe.
